Prevention: Collecting of adult from overwintering places (from root of
Artemisia plant), in pastures, foot of hills and mountains at the beginning of winter
Collecting of adults from summer hibernation places during the summer
The collected sunn pest must be buried about 50-100 cm deep
Early planting of wheat and use of early maturing varieties should be considered
Monitoring: The exact date of adult’s outbreak is 10th – 30th of
Adult feed on leaves and lay eggs underside of leaves in rows.
After the nymph emergence, both adults and nymphs feed on spike in milky stage of wheat.
They inject the saliva, which affect the wheat flour quality.
The eggs are green in color and oval in shape.
Adults have different colour from green to dark brown.
Direct control must be started when three adults were present in one square meter 2 are present then control is needed
Direct Control: Collecting of adults by hand (netting) from out breaking to the end of wheat growth season.
Harvest the crop early to control the problem
Promote natural predators by letting natural plants and shrubs grow nearby
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when spraying to protect your eyes, mouth and skin
Buy chemicals from a certified dealer and keep them out of the reach of children
Do not eat, drink or smoke during the spray
Whenever the green direct control cannot control the pest
the following pesticide must be applied: cypermethrin and malathion 1 litre/ hectare
The cypermethrin is second class and
The pesticide application time is at least 20 days before harvesting
Fenitrothion @ 1liter/ hectare can also be used to make sure the insect does not develop resistance
